Why Anthropic Is Hiring a $400,000-a-Year Natural-Gas Supply Manager

Plus: How Europe got hooked on Chinese clean tech, what the ‘Super El Niño’ means for this year’s ski season and an energy-security boost for coal demand

A recent posting on Anthropic’s job board captures the insatiable thirst for power that’s reshaping the U.S. energy system: “If gas does not arrive, in the volume and at the pressure the plant needs, the compute does not run.”

Anthropic, which is about to go public in a blockbuster IPO, is seeking a Gas Supply and Transport Lead—somebody who knows how to move natural gas around the pipeline network and keep fuel flowing to data centers. The money isn’t bad: up to $405,000 a year, double what a couple of comparable jobs recently offered.
